description: Vervoersnetwerken - Beperkingen door hoogwater en ijsvorming - EURISPORTAL is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by eurisportal.eu. Also called: Restrictions caused by flood and ice Limitations due to flooding and ice. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Transport networks - Limitations due to flooding and icing - EURISPORTAL" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Vaarwegen, INSPIRE, RIS (River Information Services), Scheepvaart, Schepen, Mobiliteit. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
